userStories.title: Token-overlap repeat-task detector
acceptanceCriteria: repeat_task.py defines tokenize(s) as lowercase whitespace-split tokens with a documented English stopword list removed; exposes overlap_ratio(a, b) = |a&b| / max(|a|,|b|).

detect_repeats(clusters, window_days) returns a list of RepeatTask(canonical_first_sentence, occurrences, example_session_ids[]) for any cluster whose first-sentence overlap_ratio >= 0.70 with 2+ other clusters in the window.
Two clusters with first-sentences of <3 non-stopword tokens are excluded from comparison (too short to overlap meaningfully) and that case is covered by a test.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis

userStories.title: Cost-savings hint per repeat
acceptanceCriteria: RepeatTask carries an estimated_minutes_per_occurrence field computed as median session duration across the cluster; the report layer uses it later to render 'a skill could reclaim ~X min/week'.
detect_repeats returns an empty list when no cluster recurs 3+ times; callers must handle the empty case (no fabricated suggestions).
An invocation with an empty clusters input returns [] without raising.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
